name: AL-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Gary Palmer running with large financial advantage
model.rationale: This Birmingham-area district leans heavily Republican, and incumbent Gary Palmer is running with over $1 million raised against a Democratic challenger who has raised under $7,000. Prediction markets price a Republican win near 96%, consistent with the district's fundamentals.
model.watch: A major scandal or unexpected incumbent retirement could open the door, but nothing in the evidence suggests such a shift.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Alabama's 6th District is a solidly Republican seat around Birmingham, with a partisan lean of about 17 points toward the GOP. Incumbent Gary Palmer is seeking another term and holds a commanding financial position, having raised over $1 million, while Democratic challenger Maurice Mercer has raised only a few thousand dollars and has no outside support. No independent polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and campaign finance. Prediction markets give Palmer roughly a 96% chance of winning. With no competitive signals in polling, fundraising, or spending, the race is rated Safe Republican, with Palmer strongly favored to return to Congress.
